title: Venezuelan Chocolate Mousse Parfait
description: A rich, chocolatey parfait made with Venezuelan chocolate, layered with a light and airy mousse and crunchy nutty elements.
instructions: Melt the Venezuelan chocolate in a double boiler.
Whisk the heavy cream and granulated sugar until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the mousse until well combined.
Spoon a layer of mousse into a serving glass or parfait dish.
Melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler and drizzle over the mousse.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of mousse.
Sprinkle the crushed nutty elements over the top.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
